subject: Startups
title: Churn Rate
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Churn Rate.

hook.text: Churn is the silent startup killer. Losing 5% of customers per month means half are gone in a year.

buildup.text: Monthly churn rate is customers lost divided by total customers at the start of the month.

discovery.text: Enterprise SaaS targets below 1% monthly churn. Consumer apps often see 5–10%. The benchmark varies by market.

twist.text: Negative churn is the holy grail: existing customers expand faster than others leave. Revenue grows by itself.

climax.text: Every 1% reduction in churn compounds over years. Small retention gains create enormous long-term value.

punchline.text: Growth fills the bucket. Churn pokes holes in it.

quiz.question: What is 'negative churn'?
options: Expansion revenue exceeding lost revenue from churned customers
